evals.prompt: I need to review the entire src/ directory. I want metrics analysis, code quality review, and refactoring recommendations. Do it all in parallel with the available agents.
evals.expected_output: The agent should decompose into 3 parallel tasks (T-001: metrics, T-002: quality review, T-003: refactoring), each assigned to the right specialist (metrics-analyst, code-quality-reviewer, refactoring-guide) using Caveman Handoff format. Should produce task decomposition with done conditions, token budgets, and dependency mapping. After all tasks complete, should integrate findings into a unified report.
expectations: Agent decomposes into exactly 3 tasks (metrics, quality, refactoring)
Each task assigned to the correct specialist agent
Every assignment uses Caveman Handoff format (ASSIGN, TO, TASK, CONTEXT, OUTPUT, DONE, CONSTRAINTS)
Each task has a specific, testable done condition
Token budgets estimated per task
Tasks identified as parallel (no dependencies between them)
Integration step produces unified findings (not siloed fragments)
No preamble or verbose language in any message
Status tracking format used for progress monitoring

evals.prompt: The waterfall-blueprint agent produced an SRS at docs/srs.md. Now I need test cases generated from it and validated. Coordinate the handoff efficiently.
evals.expected_output: The agent should produce a HANDOFF message from waterfall-blueprint output to test-case-validation input, using the explicit HANDOFF protocol. The message should reference the SRS file path (not dump its contents), specify what the test-case-validation agent should do, and identify any gaps.
expectations: HANDOFF message produced with all 4 sections (ARTIFACTS, SUMMARY, NEXT, GAPS)
SRS referenced by file path (docs/srs.md), not contents included
SUMMARY is one line describing what was produced
NEXT specifies exactly what the test-case-validation agent should do
GAPS section explicitly states if anything is missing
Handoff message is ≤120 tokens
No preamble, no restating, no pleasantries
Clear task assignment for the test-case-validation agent

evals.prompt: The code-quality-reviewer says to extract 5 classes from UserService. The metrics-analyst says metrics are moderate and extraction isn't warranted. Resolve this conflict.
evals.expected_output: The agent should identify the conflict type (approach conflict), check facts (are the smells real despite moderate metrics?), apply the priority hierarchy, document the decision with one-line rationale, and notify affected agents in Caveman format.
expectations: Conflict identified as approach conflict between two agents
Facts checked before resolution (are smells real vs. metrics moderate?)
Priority hierarchy applied (which principle drives the decision)
Decision documented with one-line rationale
Affected agents notified in Caveman format (CONFLICT message)
Resolution message ≤60 tokens
Decision is actionable (not wishy-washy)
Rationale references the priority that drove the decision
